events.verdict: Rozier (MIA) and Sabonis (SAC) briefly engage and disengage in the post.
Butler (MIA) establishes himself in Fox's (SAC) path and marginal contact occurs to Fox's side as he defends over the pick.
Herro (MIA) initiates contact to DeRozan's (SAC) arm during his upward shooting motion, affecting his jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) is firming up on his left leg and absorbs the contact as Fox (SAC) defends over the pick.
As Fox (SAC) moves around Herro (MIA), Herro leans in to initiate the marginal contact during his jump shot attempt.
Herro (MIA) reaches in and cleanly dislodges the ball during DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
DeRozan (SAC) moves forwards into Herro (MIA), causing him to lose his balance as he controls the loose ball.
Butler (MIA) is in a legal guarding position as DeRozan (SAC) briefly loses control of the ball. When the ball is loose, Rozier (MIA) reaches in and the contact with DeRozan is incidental.
Murray (SAC) contests Butler's (MIA) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Rozier (MIA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Sabonis (SAC) firms up in a screening position in Larsson's (MIA) path and does not deliver contact.
Larsson (MIA) is in a legal guarding position during Fox's (SAC) drive towards the basket.
Fox (SAC) releases away from Larsson (MIA) as he comes to a stop at the end of the drive, and Larsson's momentum carries him forwards.
Sabonis (SAC) has his hands placed against Adebayo's (MIA) back and the contact is marginal as he releases away to pursue the rebound in the opposite direction.
Adebayo (MIA) briefly has a hand placed on Sabonis's (SAC) body, but the contact is marginal and Sabonis is already off-balance when he attempts the shot.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in Murray's (SAC) path and marginal body contact occurs to his side as he defends over the screen.
